How It Works

Create professional tone comparisons in three simple steps

1

Select Your Tones

Browse your Tone 3000 library and pick the NAM models, IRs, or AIDA-X profiles you want to compare.

2

Upload Your DI

Record a DI track or upload an existing one. Our pipeline processes it through each tone model.

3

Get Your Video

Receive a side-by-side comparison video with waveforms and each tone playing in sequence.
